name: Amakami Vampire
source:
Reiju is a high school student. One day, he saves a vampire bat. He digs the ground as told and finds three coffins. When he opens them, he is surprised to see that.... Three vampire girls are inside.... The next day, they suddenly come to his school and treat him as their slave.... Will his peaceful life come back...?

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
礼寿是一名高中生。一天，他救下一只吸血蝙蝠，并按照对方的指示挖开地面，找到三具棺材。打开棺材后，眼前的景象令他大吃一惊……里面竟躺着三名吸血鬼少女……第二天，她们突然来到他的学校，把他当成奴隶使唤……礼寿平静的生活还能回来吗……？

[摘自Himeya Shop]
